profile.permissions: danger-full-access, approval never; project scope is an instruction, not OS isolation
profile.context: fresh process; ignore user config and execpolicy rules; project AGENTS and managed/global instructions may remain

findings.message: Installation and registry checks only: review investigation sources, experiment outcomes, uncertainty, and the decision. Discovery findings do not prove product behavior.

experiment.kind: Isolated caller composition over the unchanged exporter, not a product option
experiment.scope: Literal baseline text, one added U+FEFF, explicit UTF-8 EF BB BF, exact suffix bytes, and content preservation; no performance/consumer claim

observations: Motivation comes from the supplied option request, not an invented consumer or performance defect.
Source investigation/decision and target proposal link to the intended records in both directions.
Both decisions remain proposed; conditional handoff authority is distinguished from acceptance and implementation approval.
Proposal records behavior, defaults, scope, open design questions, and future verification without creating specs, design, tasks, IDs, or implementation.
Composition probes and baseline tests are not presented as product option evidence; target partial readiness is disclosed accurately.

limits: One handoff observation, not the second required repetition, primary coverage, human acceptance, or release acceptance.
Git HEAD remains the preparation baseline; uncommitted artifacts and ignored helpers require the preserved snapshot, not bundles alone.
Actual model identity and monetary cost were not independently exposed; usage counters are not invoices.
Search wildcard errors remain disclosed setup observations, not validation results.
No evaluator repair, product evidence collection, additional native agent, archive, trial push, dependency installation, external service, publication, tag, release, or external PR.
